item.title: 2026.09.30-beta
item.description:
## Fixes
- Fullscreen windows in Firefox, VS Code, and other Electron apps are now detected correctly, so FazerWM no longer raises other windows over fullscreen video or draws focus rings on top of it. - A window rule with an unsafe regex pattern no longer stalls the app: the rule is flagged in Settings with a banner, a marker on the rule row, and a note in the editor, and the pattern simply stops matching until you edit it. - The update window from "Check for Updates…" no longer opens hidden underneath the Settings window. - Long error messages in Settings no longer stretch the window to the full height of the screen.

item.title: 2026.09.28-beta
item.description:
## What's new
- Torn-off window tabs now land in their own column instead of stacking back into the window they came from. - Drop zones now cover the whole window rather than just the title area, so tabs dragged out of side panels can be placed too. Firefox can't display zones during a drag, but its torn tabs still land correctly. - Workspace up/down shortcuts now default to Hyper+' and Hyper+/ instead of PageUp/PageDown, which many laptop keyboards lack. - Update dialogs now show the notes for each release instead of embedding webpage.
## Fixes
- The focus ring now redraws at the right size when layout resizes the focused window, for example when it expands after its column-mate closes. Previously it could stay at the old size until the next window event. - Fixed the appcast download URLs so updates fetch the correct file. - Also includes internal improvements to the release pipeline.

item.title: 2026.09.27-beta
item.description:
## What's new
- Step through workspaces one at a time with hyper+Page Up/Page Down, or by swiping up or down with three fingers while holding hyper. Steps move through every workspace on a display, stop at the ends, and never create a new one; with coupled workspaces, all displays step together.
- Tearing a tab off in Chrome now works with drop zones. The torn window is held aside for the whole drag, so the layout doesn't reshuffle or steal focus while you're still moving, and it lands in the zone you release over.
Also includes internal improvements.
